plugin.note: Steel dragon strategy: weak to stab, heavy ranged, and Earth spells; dragonbane weapons are best. Usually kill only for collection log or location requirements.

requirements: Partial completion of Dragon Slayer I
mechanics: Metallic dragonfire is not blocked by Protect from Magic.
Steel dragons use melee and long-range dragonfire.
Catacombs Steel dragons are stronger and can drop Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces.

methods.label: Dragonfire protection
requiredOrKeyItems: Antifire potion or super antifire potion
steps: Use anti-dragon shield plus antifire, or super antifire.
Do not rely on Protect from Magic.
Use Protect from Melee or step out between melee attacks if using complete dragonfire protection.

methods.label: Collection log
methods.summary: Use Steel dragons mostly for collection log or location requirements rather than task speed.
steps: Use dragonbane, stab, heavy ranged, or earth spell damage.
Use Catacombs for Ancient shard and Dark totem access.

styleOptions.label: Melee dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Dragon hunter lance or high-accuracy stab weapon.

styleOptions.label: Ranged dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Dragon hunter crossbow or heavy ranged setup.

styleOptions.label: Earth Magic
styleOptions.summary: Earth spell or dragon hunter wand setup.

body:
# Steel dragon

Weak to stab, heavy ranged, and Earth spells; very high Defence. Dragon hunter lance is best stab versus draconic creatures, then fang. Do not use slash.
